Reception
In his retrospective review for
AllMusic
, Arthur Rowe gave the album 2.5 stars out of 5, opining that it was a "
bad album
" that might "have gone some
distance
toward derailing [Pat Boone's] career early on, if he "had not gotten off to a fast start with some good,
energy-charged
[...] rock & roll and also an excellent [...]
album of standards
".
